### Database Schema (SQLite)

Two tables, created in `init_db()`:

**`users` table:**
| Column        | Type    | Constraints           |
|---------------|---------|-----------------------|
| id            | INTEGER | PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT |
| username      | TEXT    | NOT NULL, UNIQUE      |
| password_hash | TEXT    | NOT NULL              |

**`tasks` table:**
| Column     | Type    | Constraints                                      |
|------------|---------|--------------------------------------------------|
| id         | INTEGER | PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT                        |
| title      | TEXT    | NOT NULL                                         |
| status     | TEXT    | NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'                       |
| created_at | TEXT    | NOT NULL (ISO format datetime string)            |
| owner_id   | INTEGER | FOREIGN KEY -> users(id)                         |

Note: `owner_id` is added with a legacy-migration `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` wrapped in a try/except for pre-existing databases.

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint               | Auth Required | Description                          | Success Code |
|--------|------------------------|---------------|--------------------------------------|--------------|
| POST   | `/auth/register`       | No            | Register new user (username, password)| 201          |
| POST   | `/auth/login`          | No            | Login, returns JWT token             | 200          |
| GET    | `/tasks`               | Yes (JWT)     | List all tasks for authenticated user| 200          |
| POST   | `/tasks`               | Yes (JWT)     | Create a new task (title required)   | 201          |
| GET    | `/tasks/<int:task_id>` | Yes (JWT)     | Get a single task by ID              | 200          |
| PUT    | `/tasks/<int:task_id>` | Yes (JWT)     | Update task title and/or status      | 200          |

### Data Access Functions (no ORM, raw SQLite)

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `get_db()` | Gets or creates SQLite connection stored in Flask `g` object |
| `close_db()` | Closes the DB on appcontext teardown |
| `init_db()` | Creates tables if not exists, migrates old schema |
| `create_user(username, password)` | Inserts user with hashed password, returns dict or None on duplicate |
| `get_user_by_username(username)` | Fetches user row as dict, or None |
| `login_required` | Decorator that validates `Authorization: Bearer <token>` JWT |
| `create_task(title, owner_id)` | Inserts task, returns dict |
| `get_tasks(owner_id)` | Returns list of task dicts for user, ordered by created_at DESC |
| `get_task(task_id, owner_id)` | Returns single task dict or None |
| `update_task(task_id, owner_id, title, status)` | Updates title/status, returns updated task or None |

**File:** `/tmp/story_117533fe8f2f/test_app.py` (424 lines)

| Class                      | # Tests | Covers |

There is **no separate configuration file** (no config.py, settings.py, .env, etc.). All configuration is done inline:

| Setting      | Source                        | Default            |

| `SECRET_KEY` | `os.environ.get("SECRET_KEY")`| `"dev-secret-key"` |

```
flask

pytest
```
